scope: Existing native results transcribed without rerunning SimulationCraft or changing acceptance decisions.
notes: DPS is descriptive only for smoke, static and export-reimport runs; these runs are not ranking evidence.
requested_iterations is read from the original input. Native reported option iterations and effective DPS samples are preserved separately.
CI95 half-width equals native mean_std_dev times native confidence_estimator; it is not a paired-difference interval.
Missing standalone acceptance is null, not an inferred success. Original validation and scientific conclusions remain authoritative.
raw_result_archived describes the dated .gitignore policy, not whether the file has already been committed.
